description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
 
 Brown & Brown is seeking a HubSpot Developer to join our growing team in Plano, TX!   
  
 The HubSpot Developer is a member of the HubSpot Delivery team within Brown & Brown’s Retail Software Engineering organization, responsible for developing, enhancing, and supporting websites and digital experiences across HubSpot and supporting web technologies. Working closely with architects, senior developers, product owners, marketing teams, and fellow delivery team members, you will build reusable components, implement platform enhancements, support integrations, and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. You will translate business and technical requirements into quality software while following established architectural direction, development standards, and engineering best practices.
 
 How You Will Contribute: 
 Develop, enhance, and support websites and digital experiences across HubSpot and supporting web technologies.
 Build and maintain reusable components, templates, modules, integrations and custom functionality using modern web practices.
 Translate business requirements and technical designs into scalable, maintainable, and secure web solutions.
 Collaborate with architects, senior developers, product owners, marketing teams, business analysts, and QA resources to refine requirements and deliver effective solutions.
 Participate in backlog refinement, estimation, implementation planning, and technical design discussions, communicating risks, dependencies, and blockers as needed.
 Perform testing, troubleshooting, defect resolution, deployment support, and root-cause analysis to support solution quality and stability.
 Follow established development standards and contribute to improvements in performance, accessibility, security, reusability, maintainability, and technical debt.
  
 Skills & Experience to be Successful:  
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 3+ years of professional software or web development experience.
 Experience developing modern web solutions, including experience with HubSpot CMS Hub or comparable CMS and web platform technologies.
 Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, APIs, and modern web development practices.
 Experience consuming APIs and developing integrations between websites, web applications, digital platforms, and enterprise systems.
 Experience working within Agile and DevOps delivery environments.
 Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
 Preferred: 
 Experience with HubSpot CMS Hub development, including custom themes, templates, modules, HubL, and HubDB.
 HubSpot CMS Hub certifications.
 Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks and C#, .NET, or other server-side development technologies.
 Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, cloud-based applications, or modern web application architectures.
 Experience supporting multi-site or multilingual web platforms.
 Experience with WordPress development, website migrations, or digital modernization initiatives.
 Understanding of insurance business processes and industry-specific challenges.
 
 Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being 
 We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:
 Health Benefits : Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance   
 Financial Benefits : ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement 
 Mental Health & Wellness : Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
 Beyond Benefits : Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more. 
 
 Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations. 

 Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement 
 Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.
 
 The Power To Be Yourself    
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment comprised of people from all backgrounds, with a variety of experiences and perspectives, guided by our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) motto, “The Power to Be Yourself”.
